prompt: No general maximum continuous fence length or maximum contributing catchment area per section is stated in the Building Sites Guidelines (2024) or the Blue Book text (only: returns usually every 20 m; sub-catchment flow limited to 50 L/s in the design storm; a model plan uses 1,030 m2 for its own site). To be confirmed by the designer/certifier.
No offset between the sediment fence and the lot boundary / limit of works is stated. The fence is drawn on the limit-of-works line; offset to be confirmed by the designer/certifier.

No stockpile setback from the lot boundary is stated (only 2 m minimum / 5 m preferred from hazard areas such as drains, driveways, concentrated flow, waterways, roads). Boundary setback to be confirmed by the designer/certifier or council.

No minimum buffer from drainage lines / waterways to disturbed ground is stated for single-lot building sites (only: no run-off may pass through sensitive areas; consult DPIRD Fisheries; stockpiles 2 m min / 5 m preferred from concentrated flow). Riparian/buffer distance to be confirmed by the designer/certifier and the relevant water agency.

Tree protection is by drip line (BS 2024 s4.3) with an arborist for guidance; a numeric protection-zone radius is not in the ingested documents (Gunnedah Engineering Standards cite AS 4970, not ingested). Tree points without canopy/TPZ radius are shown with the drip line to be confirmed by a qualified arborist.

No dimensions (length, height, spacing) for kerb inlet/gutter sediment traps are stated in text (standard drawings SD 6-11/6-12 are figures, not text). Council to be consulted on method and dimensions.
Check dam spacing and height are not stated in the ingested text. Shown only as 'where necessary' on sloping sites, location indicative; to be confirmed by the designer.
Diversion bank/catch drain cross-section and grade are not stated in text (Blue Book standard drawings SD 5-5/5-6 are figures). To be confirmed by the designer/certifier.
No wash-out size or setback from boundaries is stated other than the 2 m buffer around the largest equipment washed. Size to be set by the builder; location to be confirmed.
No portable toilet siting distance from drains/boundaries is stated. Siting is indicative (away from the downslope boundary and drains); to be confirmed by the builder/certifier.
No waste bin siting distance is stated. Bin shown within the limit of works clear of drains; to be confirmed.

Gunnedah DCP 2025 contains no ESCP requirement for a dwelling in R2; its only erosion/sediment mentions are rural stormwater (D.3) and solar farm submissions. Gunnedah Engineering Standards 2025 7.4.1 (allotment filling) cites the Blue Book. A development consent condition, if issued, governs.
Queensland ESC standards (IECA / council planning scheme codes) are not ingested; QLD sites cannot be resolved by this knowledge base.

Neither the 2024 Building Sites Guidelines nor the Blue Book requires a rainfall-percentile design storm for sediment-fence-only controls on a small lot; percentile/5-day depths apply to sediment basins. If a basin is proposed the designer must size it.

Length of fence returns (ends and every 20 m) is not stated generally (a Blue Book model plan uses 1 m for its own site). The plan draws a symbolic return; length to be confirmed by the designer/certifier.
